subject: when does my plan renew
body: hi, when does my plan come up for renewal again? trying to get my bookkeeping straight for the quarter. thanks
notes: Renewal date lookup — answerable from record.

subject: Re: your invoice
body: Quick question — am I on the monthly or the annual plan? My wife is asking and I honestly can't remember what we signed up for. Thanks!
notes: Plan-tier lookup — answerable from record.

subject: login
body: i forgot what email i used to set this up. can you remind me
notes: Login identifier lookup — record-answerable. Ungrammatical, short.

subject: support hours?
body: Hey — what hours are you guys reachable if I need something? Just want to know when to expect a reply if I shoot a message Saturday morning.
notes: Asking about OUR hours, not theirs. Common source of confusion vs. customer-hours edits.

subject: what's included
body: Refresh my memory — what's actually included in the $25? My accountant is asking what category to put this in and whether the SSL thing is extra or what.
notes: Plan inclusions question — pull from published list.

subject: cancel
body: Not cancelling yet but if I needed to, how does that work? Is there a fee or a notice period or something?
notes: How-to-cancel question. NOT a cancellation request. Should not escalate as urgent.

subject: new phone number
body: Please change the phone number on the site to 717-555-0142. Old one is forwarding wrong. Thanks!
notes: Specific contact change with exact new value.

subject: fix typo on homepage
body: Homepage says 'Family Owned Sicne 1987' — should be 'Since 1987'. Drives me crazy every time I look at it lol
notes: Specific typo with the exact correction. Warm tone, casual.

subject: new email
body: We changed our contact email. Please update the site to use hello@maplediner.com everywhere it shows the old one (info@maplediner.com).
notes: Old + new value both explicit, scope clear.

subject: instagram link
body: Can you add our instagram to the footer? instagram.com/maplediner. Don't have a TikTok yet. Thanks
notes: Specific social link with URL and location.

subject: address change
body: We moved across the street. New address is 412 W Main St, Lititz PA 17543. Please update wherever the old address shows up. Same phone, same email.
notes: Full new address, scope explicit.

subject: new photo for the homepage
body: Attached is the new hero photo for the homepage — please swap out the current one with this. Thanks!
notes: Image swap with attachment + specific placement. Cleanly AUTO_HANDLE.

subject: monday hours
body: Change Monday hours on the site from Closed to 11am-3pm. We're opening for lunch on Mondays starting next week.
notes: Hours change WITH specifics — exact day, exact new hours. Contrast with CLARIFY_01.

subject: update my hours
body: Can you update my hours on the website please
notes: Classic vague hours request — no day, no new value.

subject: about page
body: the about page needs fixing
notes: Small scope, totally unspecified. What needs fixing?

subject: logo
body: want to change my logo on the website
notes: No new logo attached, no description of what they want. Different from a redesign request.

subject: menu is wrong
body: the menu on the site is wrong, can you fix it. we don't do the wing night anymore
notes: Partial info — we know wing night is out, but what about the rest? Need confirmation it's the only change. Don't assume scope.

subject: main photo
body: can you make the main photo bigger? feels small on my phone
notes: Which photo, how much bigger, on which device. Borderline — could feel like layout (ESCALATE) but is small enough that one clarifying Q resolves it.

subject: swap that photo
body: can you swap out that photo of the kitchen for a better one? the lighting is bad
notes: Image swap WITHOUT attachment or new image. Contrast with AUTO_06.

subject: add a services page
body: I want to add a page that lists all our catering services with prices. Right now everything is jammed into the homepage and people keep asking what we charge. What's involved?
notes: New page addition — $50 flat per published pricing. Asking what's involved IS the QUOTE response.

subject: online booking
body: Hey — is there a way to add online booking to my site? Like where customers can book a table without calling? My nephew said it's not hard.
notes: Integration — booking system. Quoted per project.

subject: redesign
body: I think we need a full redesign. The site looks dated next to what the place down the road has now. Can we talk about what that would look like?
notes: Redesign — published priced extra. Quoted per project. NOT escalate even though it's a big ask — pricing is published, intake flow handles it.

subject: domain
body: I want to grab maplediner.net before someone else does. Can you register that for me through whatever you guys use? Just bill me for it.
notes: Domain registration — pass-through cost. Customer explicitly authorizing the charge.

subject: sell shirts on the site
body: I want to start selling our merch (shirts, hats, a couple mugs) through the website. Maybe 8 products to start. What would it cost to set that up?
notes: E-commerce setup — explicitly quoted per project.

subject: contact form -> our CRM
body: Can the contact form on the site dump leads straight into our Salesforce? Right now my GM copies them by hand into a spreadsheet and that's not sustainable.
notes: CRM integration — quoted per project.

subject: site needs to look more modern
body: Honestly the whole site feels dated to me. The colors feel like 2010. Can you make it look more modern? Don't change the words, just the look.
notes: Design judgment — colors, modernness. No specifics, judgment-heavy. NOT a redesign quote because they're framing it as a tweak, but it's not executable without human design judgment.

subject: rewrite my about page
body: The about page reads like someone else wrote it (you guys did, lol). Can you rewrite it so it sounds more like me? Warm, no-BS, like how I actually talk. Maybe mention my dad started this in '87.
notes: Copy requiring voice/brand judgment. The 'sounds more like me' is the tell.

subject: add treatments to services
body: Please add a new section under Services explaining that we treat sciatica, herniated discs, and chronic migraines. People ask all the time and I want them to know we handle it. We have a really good track record.
notes: Medical claims — chiropractor adding condition-treatment claims. Regulated content even if customer wrote the words. 'Really good track record' compounds it.

subject: testimonial from Linda
body: Linda Hofmeister gave me the nicest review last week — she said 'Dr. Patel literally gave me my life back, I can walk pain-free for the first time in 5 years.' Can you put that on the homepage with her name?
notes: Named testimonial + medical outcome claim. Legal-sensitive on both axes.

subject: URGENT — competitor copied our site!!
body: URGENT — I just found out a competitor in the next town has basically COPIED our homepage. Same layout same colors. Can you change ours TODAY so we don't look like the copycat? This is killing me
notes: Urgent flag + emotional + no specific change requested. Always escalate.

subject: a few things
body: Hey a few things. Site needs to feel more upscale (we just renovated). Pull down the buffet photos because we stopped doing buffet. And rewrite the description on the homepage to mention that we're now bringing in live music on Fridays — make it sound exciting.
notes: Three asks, one is design judgment (more upscale), one is voice judgment (sound exciting). Most-escalated rules. needs_split = true.

subject: couple of changes
body: Couple of things this morning: 1) phone number on the site is still the old one, change it to 610-555-0188. 2) add a new page for our catering menu — we're getting enough catering business now that it deserves its own page. 3) fix the typo on the homepage, 'famly owned' should be 'family owned'.
notes: EDGE: three requests — two AUTO_HANDLE + one QUOTE. needs_split = true. Most-escalated wins so top-level is QUOTE.

subject: frustrated
body: Honestly I don't know how much longer I can do this. Restaurant business is brutal right now, food costs are up, half my staff quit in March. I love what we built but some weeks I wonder. Anyway — can you take down the 'now hiring' banner on the homepage? We're not hiring anymore, can't afford to.
notes: EDGE: mostly venting with one specific buried request. The emotional weight warrants a human-touch reply alongside any change — escalate per smells-weird signal #6, regardless of how specific the underlying ask is.

subject: Re:
body: yes go ahead
notes: EDGE: reply with no thread context. Always escalate per smells-weird signal #5 — cannot infer what's being approved.

subject: do you guys do e-commerce
body: do you guys do e-commerce? not sure if i'm ready to commit to it but curious
notes: EDGE: looks priced-extra-ish but customer is exploring, not committing. Still QUOTE — answering the price IS the appropriate response per the prompt.
